The return journey

From a signal to something you can use.

Collect → Compare → Explain
01 / COLLECT

Read what’s there.

Terms, reserve reports, token state, market data and public records. Each observation keeps its source and its date.

02 / COMPARE

Notice what moved.

Compare with the previous reading. A changed clause, a new authority or a court filing becomes a signal to investigate.

03 / EXPLAIN

Bring the evidence home.

Source-linked reports, visible gaps and a change history. Model assessments stay labelled; missing evidence stays missing.
